$comment: npm audit advisories CI accepts until each entry expires; checked by scripts/security/check_npm_audit.py in .github/workflows/security-npm.yaml. Add an entry only for an advisory with no usable fix that does not reach production, and remove it once one ships: the check warns on an entry no longer reported (the weekly run fails on one), and fails on one past its expiry. "expires": null means no expiry; the entry then lasts until it is removed, with a warning once its advisory is no longer reported. "dev_only": true makes the check also fail if any vulnerable copy is not dev-only in package-lock.json; set it whenever the reason is that the advisory does not ship.
